description: Both mail-server and chat-server lib.rs define ClosureHandler that receives caller: C in JmapHandler::call but does not forward it to the closure. mail-server documents this in a large block comment and the register_mail_handlers doc; chat-server has no corresponding warning on ClosureHandler or register_chat_handlers. A consumer who needs per-request tenant or auth context will call register_chat_handlers and discover at runtime that CallerCtx is unreachable. The divergence between the two crates' documentation also means contributors copy-paste the chat-server pattern without realizing the mail-server restriction applies equally to chat-server.
title: ClosureHandler discards CallerCtx — undocumented API footgun
